description: Review a diff of UI code for design-system discipline: tokens instead of raw colours, a keyboard path for primary workflows, reduced-motion handling, visible focus, and loading, empty, disabled and error states. Use before merging a change to components or pages. Trigger on "review the UI in this PR", "does this follow our design system", or "check this component for keyboard and accessibility". Not for a redesign brief or a general review; use the `draft-ui-redesign` or `review-changes` skill.
